West Peek Productions/Services/Brand & creative

Brand and creative

We sharpen how an organisation shows up, what it says, and how its ideas translate into creative work people recognise and remember.

The short answer

Positioning, messaging, creative direction, campaign concepts, visual systems and launch creative.

Usually the useful version of this engagement starts with the sentence an organisation cannot currently say clearly about itself.

What we do

  • PositioningWhat this is, who it is for, and what it is instead of. The third part is the one that gets skipped and the one that does the work.
  • MessagingThe words that survive being repeated by someone who does not work in marketing.
  • Creative directionA point of view applied consistently, so the work looks like it came from one organisation.
  • Campaign conceptsAn idea with enough structure to run across formats without collapsing into a slogan.
  • Visual systemsNot a logo. The set of decisions that let other people make on-brand things without asking.
  • Launch creativeThe concentrated version, for the moment when attention is briefly available.

Why this sits next to production

Brand work that never gets built stays a document. Production work with no brand behind it produces well-executed events that feel like they came from nobody in particular. Keeping both under one partner is the point of the service model here — and it is why we argue for one partner over five disconnected vendors.
